source_findings.source: Read directly from protected 5cd442c probe source state (unchanged at doc base 2980738) and pinned 78-file Husk119 source-check archive; no device execution.
source_findings.probe_direct_enable: experiments/linux-guest/ios/LinuxProbeView.swift:83 directly invokes jit.enable() with no explicit setup button or JIT status/error/busy rendering.
source_findings.probe_only_route: LinuxProbeView.swift:32-34 IDECK_LINUX_PROBE_ONLY bypasses ContentView/SettingsTab and opens only LinuxProbeView.
source_findings.automatic_method: Pinned src/app/Husk/JITSetup.swift:138-143 automatic chooses StikDebug, then TrollStore, then jailbreak, then built-in.
source_findings.false_positive_detection: Pinned src/app/Husk/JITBootstrap.swift:245-247 treats canOpenURL(apple-magnifier://) as TrollStore installed; a system URL handler does not prove TrollStore installation.
source_findings.launch: Pinned JITBootstrap.swift:288-300 launches apple-magnifier://enable-jit?bundle-id=... and returns success when the URL can be opened.
source_findings.upstream_card_behavior: Pinned JITCard.swift:18-21,147-150 offers available built-in JIT and sets method=builtIn before enable; the Linux direct button omitted this behavior.
source_findings.setup_exists: Pinned JITSetupView.swift:66-101 supports on-device pairing, file import, VPN/enable and other methods; LinuxProbeView.swift:92 already owns a JITSetupFlow sheet, but its plain enable route may not present it until a failed TrollStore timeout.
source_findings.hidden_diagnostics: JITSetup.swift:218-235 sets busy/status and waits up to 60 seconds before showing setup on failed TrollStore; LinuxProbeView does not render those coordinator states.
source_findings.start_gate: LinuxProbeSession.swift:19-21 refuses to start without JITBootstrap.ready and successful prewarm/live/MAP_JIT path; runtime gates must remain.
source_findings.reuse_boundary: Pinned SettingsTab.swift:569-575 JITSettings includes Start Android on launch; do not restore whole ContentView/SettingsTab or unrelated Android state just to expose pairing.
source_findings.callback_mismatch: Read directly: pinned JITSetup.swift:407 hard-codes localdevvpn://enable?scheme=husk. Current package_probe.py:43-44 overwrites CFBundleURLTypes with only ideck-linux-probe, so the callback names another scheme.
source_findings.extension_identity_boundary: Pinned JITBuiltIn.swift:60-64 resolves helper ID from embedded Info.plist; no proven broken rename/BG-task identity. SideStore rewriting behavior is not treated as an established error.
source_findings.pairing_store_boundary: Pinned JITSetup.swift:39-43 stores pairing in this app Documents/StikJIT/pairingFile.plist. A dedicated probe does not automatically inherit the original Husk app Documents pairing.

fix.trollstore: Require the existing per-app TrollStore installation marker both for installed detection and explicit attach before considering apple-magnifier://, so SideStore cannot identify stock Magnifier as TrollStore.
fix.callback: Build LocalDevVPN scheme query with URLComponents from actual Bundle.main CFBundleURLTypes/CFBundleURLSchemes; keep husk fallback only when no scheme is registered.
fix.linux_ui: Expose explicit JIT setup and method action using the original JITSetupFlow; display coordinator busy/status/error; prefer available built-in only when method is Automatic, retaining explicit user selections.
fix.execution_truth: Publish actual execution-check state from session claim/start actions, separate from debugger attach. No JIT probe is performed in a SwiftUI view body. Existing ready/prewarm/live/MAP_JIT start gate remains.
fix.pairing_flow: Original walkthrough remains owner-driven: on-device pairing or file import, Settings/Developer Mode/PIN when using on-device flow, LocalDevVPN, Check setup/DDI, Enable, then actual execution check before Linux.
fix.preserve: Linux one-session isolation, native pins, original source-check archive and successful 5cd IPA; no restored Android library startup.
fix.apple_and_device_validation: Not performed for this source fix.
